headline: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady, signals cautious outlook
summary: The Federal Reserve voted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged at its latest policy meeting. Officials cited mixed signals on inflation and employment as reasons for a wait-and-see approach. The decision was in line with most analyst forecasts. Fed Chair comments afterward emphasized that future moves will depend on incoming economic data, and markets showed a muted reaction to the announcement.

sources.name: Reuters
sources.title: Fed holds rates steady, cites inflation uncertainty
sources.commentary: Sticks to a wire-service register — states the decision and the Fed's stated reason without added framing or evaluative language.

sources.name: The Wall Street Journal
sources.title: Fed Pauses Again as Officials Weigh Sticky Inflation
sources.commentary: Uses 'sticky inflation' to keep inflation-persistence as the central worry, a framing that tends to favor caution over rate cuts.

sources.name: CNN
sources.title: Fed leaves rates unchanged, but relief for consumers may still be far off
sources.commentary: Frames the decision through its effect on household budgets, emphasizing delayed 'relief' rather than the Fed's inflation rationale.

sources.name: Fox Business
sources.title: Fed keeps rates on hold as Powell warns against premature cuts
sources.commentary: Leads with Powell's warning against cutting too soon, foregrounding the hawkish argument over the case for easing.

headline: Lawmakers reach short-term deal to avoid government shutdown
summary: Congressional leaders from both parties agreed to a short-term funding measure to keep the government running past the current deadline. The stopgap bill extends funding at existing levels while negotiators continue working on full-year appropriations. The measure passed with bipartisan support, though some members of both parties objected to elements of the compromise. The bill now heads to the President's desk.

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.title: Congress passes stopgap bill to avert shutdown
sources.commentary: Plain statement of the legislative outcome with no framing beyond what happened.

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.title: Shutdown Averted, but Deeper Fights Loom Over Spending
sources.commentary: Notes the deal while flagging unresolved spending fights ahead — analytical rather than taking a side on who's to blame.

sources.name: National Review
sources.title: GOP Holdouts Blast Leadership Over Spending Deal
sources.commentary: Centers intra-party GOP dissent and uses 'blast,' framing the deal as a compromise leadership imposed on its own base.

sources.name: NPR
sources.title: Congress avoids shutdown with short-term funding patch
sources.commentary: Neutral procedural framing — 'patch' describes the mechanism without assigning credit or blame to either party.

headline: Ceasefire talks continue amid ongoing regional conflict
summary: Diplomats from multiple countries met to discuss terms of a potential ceasefire in an ongoing regional conflict. Officials described the talks as constructive but said significant gaps remain on key issues, including humanitarian access and security guarantees. Aid organizations report worsening conditions for civilians in affected areas. No formal agreement has been announced, and negotiators say discussions will continue in the coming days.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.title: Ceasefire talks resume as civilian toll mounts
sources.commentary: Pairs the diplomatic update with the human cost, a common wire/broadcast framing that doesn't assign blame to a side.

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.title: Negotiators meet again as humanitarian crisis deepens
sources.commentary: Emphasizes the humanitarian crisis over the diplomatic process, a framing that foregrounds civilian suffering.

sources.name: The Washington Post
sources.title: Ceasefire talks show modest progress, officials say
sources.commentary: Attributes the 'progress' characterization to officials rather than asserting it directly — a hedged, source-attributed framing.

sources.name: Fox News
sources.title: Ceasefire talks drag on as allies press for resolution
sources.commentary: Frames the talks as stalled ('drag on') and centers allied pressure for a resolution, rather than the humanitarian angle.

headline: Major tech companies report quarterly earnings above expectations
summary: Several large technology companies posted quarterly revenue and profit figures that exceeded Wall Street estimates, driven largely by growth in cloud computing and AI-related products. Executives pointed to continued enterprise demand as a key factor. Shares of some companies rose in after-hours trading following the reports, while others were more muted as investors weighed forward guidance for the coming quarter.

sources.name: CNBC
sources.title: Tech giants beat earnings estimates on AI, cloud strength
sources.commentary: Standard business-desk framing crediting AI and cloud growth, without a political angle.

sources.name: Bloomberg
sources.title: Big Tech Earnings Top Forecasts as AI Spending Pays Off
sources.commentary: Frames AI investment as vindicated ('pays off'), aimed at investors rather than a political audience.

sources.name: Forbes
sources.title: Tech Earnings Beat Expectations, But Guidance Is Mixed
sources.commentary: Balances the beat with a caution on forward guidance — even-handed business framing.

sources.name: USA Today
sources.title: Tech companies post strong earnings, stocks react
sources.commentary: Brief, descriptive framing aimed at a general-interest audience with no evaluative language.

headline: Administration announces changes to immigration enforcement policy
summary: The administration unveiled new guidance on immigration enforcement priorities, adjusting how resources are allocated for processing and removals. Supporters say the changes will focus enforcement on public-safety cases, while critics argue the policy is either too lenient or too restrictive, depending on their political perspective. The change follows months of internal review and is expected to face legal challenges from advocacy groups on multiple sides of the issue.

sources.name: The Washington Times
sources.title: New enforcement guidance sparks border security concerns
sources.commentary: Frames the change primarily through border-security risk, foregrounding concern over the policy's stated public-safety focus.

sources.name: HuffPost
sources.title: Advocates say new immigration policy still falls short
sources.commentary: Centers immigrant-advocate criticism that the policy doesn't go far enough, framing it as an incomplete reform.

sources.name: Politico
sources.title: White House shifts immigration enforcement priorities
sources.commentary: Descriptive, process-oriented framing that reports the shift without characterizing it as too harsh or too lenient.

sources.name: Newsmax
sources.title: Critics blast new immigration rules as too soft
sources.commentary: Uses 'blast' and 'too soft' to frame the policy as an enforcement rollback, leading with the harshest enforcement-critical viewpoint.

headline: Severe storm system brings flooding and power outages to multiple states
summary: A large storm system moved across several states, producing heavy rainfall, flooding, and widespread power outages. Local officials issued evacuation advisories in some low-lying areas and opened emergency shelters. Utility crews are working to restore electricity, with full restoration expected to take several days in the hardest-hit regions. No fatalities have been confirmed, though authorities warn conditions remain dangerous in some areas.

sources.name: The Weather Channel via AP
sources.title: Storm system floods roads, knocks out power across region
sources.commentary: Straightforward description of storm impacts with no evaluative framing.

sources.name: CBS News
sources.title: Thousands without power as storms sweep through
sources.commentary: Leads with the human impact (power loss) in plain, non-partisan language typical of disaster coverage.

sources.name: ABC News
sources.title: Flooding forces evacuations as storm moves east
sources.commentary: Neutral, event-driven framing focused on the immediate safety response.

sources.name: New York Post
sources.title: Brutal storm slams region, leaves trail of damage
sources.commentary: More vivid, tabloid-style language ('brutal,' 'slams') than the others, but not politically coded — sensational rather than partisan.
